mapper.select:
SELECT
TO_CHAR(ifnull(S.SCHEDULE_DATE, F.SCHEDULE_DATE), 'yyyy"年"mm"月"dd"日"')
concat(TO_CHAR(#{dto.queryStartDate}, 'yyyy"年"mm"月"dd"日"') , '-' , TO_CHAR(#{dto.queryEndDate}, 'yyyy"年"mm"月"dd"日"') )
SCHEDULE_DATE, ifnull(S.MIX_AREA, F.MIX_AREA) MIX_AREA, ifnull(S.MAJOR_TYPE, F.MAJOR_TYPE) PROCEDURE, ifnull(S.ORDER_QTY, 0) ORDER_QTY, ifnull(S.GLUE, F.GLUE) PLAN_SPEC, ifnull(S.PLAN_QTY, 0) PLAN_QTY, ifnull(F.QTY, 0) FINISH_QTY, concat(CASE WHEN ifnull(S.PLAN_QTY, 0) != 0 THEN ifnull(ROUND(F.QTY / S.PLAN_QTY, 4), 0) ELSE 0 END * 100 , '%') FINISH_RATE FROM (SELECT
R.SCHEDULE_DATE,
L.MIX_AREA, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN INSTR(L.ORDER_NO, '_') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(L.ORDER_NO, 1, INSTR(L.ORDER_NO, '_') - 1) ELSE L.ORDER_NO END) ORDER_QTY, M.MATERIAL_NAME GLUE, SUM(L.PLAN_QTY) PLAN_QTY, M.MAJOR_TYPE FROM T_MIX_SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_RECORD R INNER JOIN T_SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_LOG L ON L.RECORD_ID = R.ID INNER JOIN T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL M ON M.MATERIAL_CODE = L.RECIPE_MATERIAL_CODE AND M.MAJOR_TYPE IN ('5', '4', '2') AND M.del_flag = '0'
AND M.MAJOR_TYPE = #{dto.procedure}
WHERE R.SCHEDULE_DATE BETWEEN #{dto.queryStartDate} AND #{dto.queryEndDate}
AND L.MIX_AREA = #{dto.mixArea}
AND L.PUBLISH_RESULT = '1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 0 FROM T_SCHEDULE_PUBLISH_LOG LL WHERE L.PUBLISH_RESULT = LL.PUBLISH_RESULT AND L.ORDER_NO = LL.ORDER_NO
AND (L.CREATE_TIME < LL.CREATE_TIME OR L.CREATE_TIME = LL.CREATE_TIME AND L.ID < LL.ID))
GROUP BY L.MIX_AREA, M.MATERIAL_NAME, M.MAJOR_TYPE
,R.SCHEDULE_DATE
) S
FULL JOIN ( SELECT
F.SCHEDULE_DATE,
F.MIX_AREA, M.MAJOR_TYPE, F.GLUE, SUM(ifnull(F.MID_FINISH_QTY, 0) + ifnull(F.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0) + ifnull(F.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0)) QTY FROM T_GLUE_FINISH F INNER JOIN (SELECT M.MATERIAL_NAME, MAX(M.MAJOR_TYPE) MAJOR_TYPE FROM T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL M WHERE M.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND M.MAJOR_TYPE IN ('5', '4')
AND M.MAJOR_TYPE = #{dto.procedure}
GROUP BY MATERIAL_NAME) M ON F.GLUE = M.MATERIAL_NAME
WHERE F.SCHEDULE_DATE BETWEEN #{dto.queryStartDate} AND #{dto.queryEndDate}
AND F.MIX_AREA = #{dto.mixArea}
AND F.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY
F.SCHEDULE_DATE,
F.MIX_AREA, F.GLUE, M.MAJOR_TYPE
UNION
SELECT
F.SCHEDULE_DATE,
F.MIX_AREA, M.MAJOR_TYPE, F.MATERIAL_NAME GLUE, SUM(ifnull(F.MID_FINISH_QTY, 0) + ifnull(F.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, 0) + ifnull(F.DAY_FINISH_QTY, 0)) QTY FROM T_LHFL_FINISH F INNER JOIN (SELECT M.MATERIAL_NAME, MAX(M.MAJOR_TYPE) MAJOR_TYPE FROM T_MES_BAS_MATERIAL M WHERE M.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND M.MAJOR_TYPE IN ('2')
AND M.MAJOR_TYPE = #{dto.procedure}
GROUP BY MATERIAL_NAME) M ON F.MATERIAL_NAME = M.MATERIAL_NAME WHERE F.SCHEDULE_DATE BETWEEN #{dto.queryStartDate} AND #{dto.queryEndDate}
AND F.MIX_AREA = #{dto.mixArea}
AND F.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY
F.SCHEDULE_DATE,
F.MIX_AREA, F.MATERIAL_NAME, M.MAJOR_TYPE
) F ON S.MIX_AREA = F.MIX_AREA AND S.GLUE = F.GLUE AND S.MAJOR_TYPE = F.MAJOR_TYPE
AND S.SCHEDULE_DATE = F.SCHEDULE_DATE
WHERE (ifnull(S.PLAN_QTY, 0) != 0 OR ifnull(F.QTY, 0) != 0) ORDER BY SCHEDULE_DATE, MIX_AREA, PROCEDURE DESC, PLAN_SPEC
